column1: # Personal-data occurrences the sweep has not removed yet: rule, path, allowed count, tab-separated.
# This file only shrinks. An entry is deleted when its rule drops to zero for that path, and the
# ratchet fails when a path carries more occurrences than it allows here. A count is what the ratchet
# measured on the revision that added it, never a round number.
# The entries below are one defect seen from several sides: an authored site column in the i18n tables
# held an absolute path from the machine that authored it, and the generator then copied that path into
# the review document and into three prose files. They are removed by the change that makes the authored
# site columns relative to the repository, which is why this list is expected to reach zero rather than
# to stay: a public repository must not name anybody's machine or directory layout.
